polityNote: The Gambia, independent 1965-02-18. First-level units: the City of Banjul (Bathurst), Kombo St Mary / Kanifing, and the five divisions (regions from 2007). Atoms: the 8 local government areas of geoBoundaries GMB ADM1 (Knippenberg & Meyer / World Bank, 2020, CC BY 4.0); each division is one LGA except MacCarthy Island / Central River (Janjanbureh + Kuntaur). The LGAs carry census populations from 1963 to 2003 under the same names (Statoids). ① Atom area vs Statoids 1993 division area (km²): Upper River 2,035/2,069, Western 1,771/1,764, North Bank 2,216/2,256, Lower River 1,545/1,618, MacCarthy Island 2,978/2,894, Kanifing 53/76, Banjul 9/12; country 10,608/10,689 (0.99).
